reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts
  FROM activation_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT user_id, session_no, MIN(event_ts) AS session_start, COUNT(*) AS events
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY user_id, session_no
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  ROUND(AVG(events), 2) AS avg_events
FROM sessions
WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start) AS DATE)

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts,
    LEAD(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS next_ts
  FROM activation_events
), starts AS (
  -- one row per session start
  SELECT user_id, event_ts AS session_start,
    LEAD(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS next_start
  FROM gaps
  WHERE prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
), sized AS (
  -- one row per session start
  SELECT s.session_start,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activation_events e
     WHERE e.user_id = s.user_id AND e.event_ts >= s.session_start
       AND (s.next_start IS NULL OR e.event_ts < s.next_start)) AS events
  FROM starts s
  WHERE s.session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND s.session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  ROUND(AVG(events), 2) AS avg_events
FROM sized
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start) AS DATE)

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM activation_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, sn) SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', st AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS sessions, ROUND(AVG(n), 2) AS avg_events FROM ss WHERE st >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND st < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1
